bridgedStats.description: Aggregate vote counts asserted by the bridge for content federated from an origin platform (e.g. Lemmy). These supplement, and are kept separate from, native atproto votes.

asOf.description: Timestamp the origin-platform counts were sampled; used to discard stale updates

downvotes.description: Number of downvotes on the origin platform as of asOf

upvotes.description: Number of upvotes on the origin platform as of asOf

main.description: A comment on a post or another comment. Comments live in user repositories and support nested threading.

bridgedStats.description: Bridge-asserted aggregate of origin-platform votes for federated/bridged content. Set by the bridge that materialized this record; absent for natively-authored comments.

facets.description: Annotations for rich text (mentions, links, formatting, block structure)

langs.description: Languages used in the comment content (ISO 639-1)

reply.description: Reference to the post and parent being replied to

replyRef.description: References for maintaining thread structure. Root always points to the original post, parent points to the immediate parent (post or comment).

parent.description: Strong reference to the immediate parent (post or comment) being replied to

root.description: Strong reference to the original post that started the thread
